messages.subject: Distance v. transect
parts:
Distance Group:

I am currently designing a study to estimate population density of Cuban
huita. This species is a nocturnal rodent that is largely arboreal.
Habitat types we will be sampling are: Tropical Arid Scrub, Tropical Arid
Forest, Mangrove Forest, and Palm Scrub Woodland.

A colleague involved in the design suggested using program Transect, and my
experience is limited using program Distance. My question is, has anyone
evaluated the difference between using program Distance or Transect? Does
anyone have an opinion as to which would work best for the surveys I will be
conducting.

Deanna Higginson
